question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: For a long time, (a) ------- have been using the advantages of computer technology. Social networking services also have the (b) ------- to support them in the education sector. These services can reach (c) ------- of people globally. A large number of users of social networks belong to the (d) - ------ generation, especially students. As a result, online education programmes are now growing alongside (e) ------- methods to support learning. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) educationists; (b) potential; (c) millions; (d) young; (e) conventional;
